subject: Logic
title: Why Paradoxes Matter
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Why Paradoxes Matter.

hook.text: Paradoxes aren't just brain teasers. They've toppled mathematical systems and rewritten physics.

buildup.text: Russell's paradox forced mathematicians to rebuild the foundations of set theory from scratch.

discovery.text: Einstein's twin paradox helped explain how time actually works in relativity.

twist.text: Every paradox is a stress test for our reasoning. The cracks they reveal lead to better theories.

climax.text: Far from being useless puzzles, paradoxes drive intellectual progress by exposing hidden flaws.

quiz.question: How did Russell's paradox impact mathematics?
options: It forced a rebuild of set theory
